## Delivered and boundaries

FormDefinition/Condition reuse P19's requests/catalog/api.ts (equivalent existing ownership); features/forms owns the pure validator, reusable renderer, validation API/preview page and identity-bound in-memory drafts. Text/long text, numeric, PHP currency, date/Manila date-time, single/multiple stable choices, checkbox, current eligible member/unit, validated HTTPS URL, finalized file references and repeatable lines render with labels, help, required state, error descriptions and keyboard error-summary links. Repeatable row and empty-group errors focus the exact child control or described fieldset. Native P12 upload/finalize controls are reused only with an independently authorized origin-work context; without it no file bytes are staged or uploaded. Finalized file selection grants no additional byte entitlement.

Migration028 adds request_form_options and validate_request_form. Both independently require current published type/core/workspace scope; options additionally enforce directory/current term and current work-edit/file-origin/classification scope. Initial selector eligibility is active core members visible in read_directory and nonarchived same-term units; it grants no assignment or approver authority. Caps:200 visible eligible member/unit choices,100 finalized file choices,50 total configured fields including line children,10 sections,100 total lines across groups, depth4/arity5 conditions,100000-byte schema/payload and8000-byte conditions. Fixed equality/membership/numeric AND/OR operators; no executable JS/SQL/admin regex/formulas. Browser and trusted SQL repeat validation, reject unknown/prototype-shaped/protected/newly hidden fields, ineligible/stale selectors, invalid choices/calendar values/URLs and excessive sizes. Newly hidden browser values are removed immediately; a forged direct API hidden value is rejected.

Currency entry parses decimal PHP into exact integer centavos, sent through the typed bigint p_requested_centavos parameter, outside ordinary p_values JSON. Only the fixed requested_centavos currency binding is collected in this slice. Other finance/workflow fields remain read-only/fail-closed; approval identity/authorized ceilings/decisions cannot be entered or forged. No financial record/authorization is created. Successful replies include stable option IDs and definition/directory display snapshots; P21 must persist the applicable version, restricted payload and typed finance mapping in its own authorized transaction, revalidating at save/submit rather than treating this preview result as authority.

/requests/services/:typeId/preview is explicitly validation-only, linked from requirements. It never saves a database draft, submits a case, allocates a request number or grants approval. Current version mismatch fails; safe inputs remain in memory across access/choice refetch, failure and routine remount, clear on identity change and stay bound to version/origin. No localStorage/sessionStorage payload persistence or automatic draft migration. No fake connected fallback or success; success says nothing was submitted or approved.

Simulated product/security/skeptical review is one assistant's analysis, not separate reviewers: validation preview delivers the requested fields before P21; fake Submit would misstate missing case handling. Reuse the authorized P12 file service instead of inventing a second upload path, and keep protected amounts separate from ordinary JSON. The credible alternative of JSON money or editable approval fields violates the protected-data contract. Definition metadata and synthetic examples cannot establish institutional authority or real privacy acceptance.
